news.title: Rodri capture can catapult Barcelona back to very top of European game: GOAL grades the biggest deals of the 2026 summer transfer window
news.lede: For some football fans, the summer is the part of the calendar that they look forward to the most - and that's not just because it's filled by a World Cup every four years! Rather, it's because the end of the season means only one thing: It's time for transfers! The 2026 window is once again proving to be busy, with some huge names making big-money moves before deadline day on September 1. We know that some transfers turn out well for all parties involved, but there are plenty where at least one of the clubs, or even the player, are left wondering what might have been had they made a different decision while at the negotiating table.

news.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' football sells for $4.19 million
news.lede: The ball is also famous for Maradona’s “Goal of the Century” scored in the same match against England. The ball that Argentine footballer Diego Maradona used to score his controversial “Hand of God” goal against England in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final was sold at an auction on Aug 22 for US$3.3 million (S$4.19 million). The winning bid fell short of the US$10 million estimate that US-based Heritage Auctions house attached to what it called “the most significant football”. Bidding for the ball, which went down in sporting history after Maradona famously punched it past English goalkeeper Peter Shilton in Argentina’s 2-1 quarter-final win, opened at US$2.5 million.

news.title: Before Brazil, Panama friendly awaits India
news.lede: PANAJI: India are moving towards playing an unprecedented four, possibly even five, games against FIFA World Cup 2026 opponents this year, after the All India Football Federation (AIFF) signed a letter of intent with 44-ranked Panama for an international friendly at home during the Sept-Oct match window.The Panama game is scheduled for the weekend of Sept 26-27. The venue is yet to be finalised.Given that India play Brazil in Kolkata on Oct 3 and there are two away games against New Zealand in Nov, the next three months will see the team play four times against teams from the last World Cup.“. There is a high possibility of an international friendly against another participant in the World Cup on Oct 6,” a senior AIFF official told TOI.“. Talks are ongoing with three countries who featured in the last World Cup (for the third friendly).”
